title: Sub Hollow
prompt: aphex twin. Energy: mid groove, heavy. Register focus: bass-led. Palette: RolandTR808 kit + detuned sine sub. Tempo: 142 BPM. Arc shape: two peaks with a valley between. Mood modifier: dark, woozy, detuned.
description: A heavy, bass-led 808 groove rolls under a detuned sine sub that crushes and bends woozily. The track climbs to a first peak, drops into a hollow filtered valley, then rebuilds into a darker, dirtier second peak before stripping back to bare kick and sub.
code:
setcpm(142/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(1.05),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").detune(0.12).lpf(perlin.range(180,360).slow(7)).gain(0.6)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(1.1),
    s("hh(5,8,2)").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.5).pan(perlin.range(0.3,0.7)),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").detune(0.15).crush(7).lpf(perlin.range(220,520).slow(9)).gain(0.62)
  )],
  [28, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] [~ bd]").bank("RolandTR808").gain(1.1),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.55).shape(0.2),
    s("hh(7,16,3)").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.5).cut(1).pan(perlin.range(0.2,0.8)),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0 c1 bb0 f1 g0>*4").s("sine").detune(0.18).crush(6).shape(0.3).lpf(perlin.range(300,900).slow(11)).gain(0.65)
      .off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.35))
  )],
  [20, stack(
    note("<c2 eb2 g1 bb1>").s("sine").detune(0.2).crush(5).lpf(perlin.range(160,420).slow(13)).gain(0.6)
      .every(4, x => x.rev()),
    s("hh(3,8)").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.4).vowel("<a o>")
  )],
  [30, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] bd").bank("RolandTR808").gain(1.12),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.55).shape(0.35),
    s("lt(3,8,1)").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.5).speed(0.9),
    s("hh(9,16,2)").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.52).cut(1).pan(perlin.range(0.15,0.85)),
    note("<c1 eb1 g0 bb0 c1 f1 ab0 g0>*4").s("sine").detune(0.22).crush(5).shape(0.4).lpf(perlin.range(360,1100).slow(15)).gain(0.66)
      .ply("<1 1 2 1 4>").sometimesBy(0.2, x => x.speed(2))
  )],
  [12, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(1.0),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").detune(0.1).crush(8).lpf(perlin.range(160,300).slow(9)).gain(0.58)
  )]
)
